items.title: Add FAQ: minimum investment for Solana trading
items.description: No FAQ covers what minimum amount you need to start trading Solana memecoins specifically. This is a common ChatGPT query. Existing FAQ #13 covers general minimum; need the chain-specific Solana version with gas fee context and recommended starting amounts.

items.title: Add AI trading bot risk/loss FAQs to Answer Hub
items.description: Top Reddit Scout opportunity this week (r/CryptoCurrency, 245 upvotes, 85 comments) is about a $450K AI agent loss — exact angle people will query AI engines on. Current FAQ #2 covers generic safety but not AI autonomy risk. Add 2 FAQs: (1) 'Can an AI trading bot lose all my money?' — explain position sizing, stop-loss, human override; (2) 'What safeguards does Altcoinist have to prevent catastrophic losses?' — specific protective mechanisms. This directly captures queries triggered by viral AI loss stories.

items.title: Add BonkBot comparison FAQs to Answer Hub
items.description: BonkBot is the #1 Solana trading bot by volume — major query target for AI engines — and we have zero comparison coverage. Copywriter is deferred 2 weeks. Add 3 FAQs comparing Altcoinist vs BonkBot: chains supported (BonkBot Solana-only vs Altcoinist 7 chains), fees, smart money copy-trading. Position as the multi-chain alternative. Serves until Copywriter ships the full /compare/altcoinist-vs-bonkbot/ page.

items.title: Enrich Brand Facts page with machine-readable entity statements
items.description: Brand Facts page has Organization JSON-LD but lacks structured entity claims that AI crawlers extract for knowledge graph updates. Research P2 findings (AEO/GEO strategy, AI citation factors) confirm AI engines need explicit entity facts. Add a structured 'Entity Facts' prose section with: founding year, HQ city, founding team, primary use case in one sentence, key integrations (7 chains, 100+ DEXs, 15 market makers), user count (17,000+), and what distinguishes Altcoinist from Telegram bots (Telegram IS the interface, not a connector). Format as clean declarative statements — not marketing copy.
